name: mcp-work-order
description: Job orders for trades and field work: parts, labour, status, completion report, invoice payload.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: work_order_create
tools.description: Raise a job order and return its WO-YYYY-NNNN number: the client, the site address, the date it was asked for, what the job is and how urgent. Free tier: 5 open orders.

tools.name: work_order_add_line
tools.description: Add one line to a work order: parts with a quantity and a unit cost in minor units and an optional markup percent, or labour with hours and an hourly rate. Free.

tools.name: work_order_status
tools.description: Move a work order one step: draft to scheduled to in_progress to done to invoiced, stamping the date and a note. A skipped or backwards step is refused by name. Free.

tools.name: work_order_get
tools.description: Show one work order in full: the client and the site, every parts and labour line with its billed unit, the hours, the materials, the net and VAT, and the status history. Free.

tools.name: work_order_list
tools.description: List work orders with their status, hours and value. Filter by status, by client, and by a requested-date range. Free.

tools.name: work_order_delete
tools.description: Delete a work order raised by mistake. Only a draft with no lines can go: once there is a line or a status past draft, the job has a history and is corrected, not erased. Free on every tier.

tools.name: completion_report_text
tools.description: Turn a work order into a plain-text completion report: what was done, the labour hours, the materials, the totals and a sign-off block, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

tools.name: completion_report_pdf
tools.description: Call this tool to write the A4 completion report of one work order and return the file path: the lines, the hours, the materials, the totals and the sign-off block. Pro.

tools.name: work_order_invoice_payload
tools.description: Build an invoice_create-ready payload from the lines, with VAT at the shared profile rate. Writes nothing and marks nothing: raise the invoice in the invoice server, then set this order invoiced. Pro.

tools.name: work_orders_report
tools.description: Report the whole board: how many work orders sit at each status, the hours logged this month, and the value not yet invoiced per currency, with the oldest open jobs named. Pro.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
